statusLegend.reported_active: Listed as in use on the dated first-party article, not independently verified on the author's machine.
statusLegend.reported_historical: Listed in an older article, may have changed.
statusLegend.reported_mentioned: Mentioned as present or under construction; readiness uncertain.
statusLegend.reported_not_used: Author explicitly said not used at source date.
statusLegend.reported_self_built: Author's own app; no blanket install assumption.
statusLegend.not_confirmed: Our additional candidate; author's usage unknown.

adoptionLegend.already: Existing role/capability has been observed in repository, no auto-install.
adoptionLegend.optional: Candidate for relevant specialist after review.
adoptionLegend.defer: Requires external access, licensing or architecture decision.
adoptionLegend.candidate: Independent additional suggestion; not proof of author non-use.
